meta.title: Quantum Bit Initialization
meta.description: When you get down to it, if you didn't know what the future held in store for you, perhaps it might have been nothing more than a coincidental interaction between two worlds.

units.rawText: At the Future Gadget Lab.
units.displayText: At the Future Gadget Lab.

spans.text: At the Future Gadget Lab.

units.rawText: Okabe, why are you spacing out over there by yourself?
units.displayText: Okabe, why are you spacing out over there by yourself?

spans.text: Okabe, why are you spacing out over there by yourself?

units.rawText: —I know that voice.
units.displayText: —I know that voice.

spans.text: —I know that voice.

units.rawText: When I open my eyes, I see a familiar red-haired girl looking unhappily at me.
units.displayText: When I open my eyes, I see a familiar red-haired girl looking unhappily at me.

spans.text: When I open my eyes, I see a familiar red-haired girl looking unhappily at me.

units.rawText: ...Kurisu?
units.displayText: ...Kurisu?

spans.text: ...Kurisu?

units.rawText: ..Don't just call my name out of nowhere.
units.displayText: ..Don't just call my name out of nowhere.

spans.text: ..Don't just call my name out of nowhere.

units.rawText: Kurisu's eyebrows are unknit, and she sighs in mild exasperation.
units.displayText: Kurisu's eyebrows are unknit, and she sighs in mild exasperation.

spans.text: Kurisu's eyebrows are unknit, and she sighs in mild exasperation.

units.rawText: The Kurisu before me is definitely real. Though she has a sour look on her face, this emotion is the proof that she is alive.
units.displayText: The Kurisu before me is definitely real. Though she has a sour look on her face, this emotion is the proof that she is alive.

spans.text: The Kurisu before me is definitely real. Though she has a sour look on her face, this emotion is the proof that she is alive.

units.rawText: At last... I got to see you again...
units.displayText: At last... I got to see you again...

spans.text: At last... I got to see you again...

units.rawText: ...What did you just say?
units.displayText: ...What did you just say?

spans.text: ...What did you just say?

units.rawText: No, It's nothing.
units.displayText: No, It's nothing.

spans.text: No, It's nothing.

units.rawText: Much as I would like to rush up and verify the fact that she exists, the Kurisu in this world line probably doesn't know what happened before this.
units.displayText: Much as I would like to rush up and verify the fact that she exists, the Kurisu in this world line probably doesn't know what happened before this.

spans.text: Much as I would like to rush up and verify the fact that she exists, the Kurisu in this world line probably doesn't know what happened before this.

units.rawText: I force myself to calm down.
units.displayText: I force myself to calm down.

spans.text: I force myself to calm down.

units.rawText: In any case, quit dawdling and get over to MayQueen+Nyan²! Everyone's waiting for us!
units.displayText: In any case, quit dawdling and get over to MayQueen+Nyan²! Everyone's waiting for us!

spans.text: In any case, quit dawdling and get over to MayQueen+Nyan²! Everyone's waiting for us!

units.rawText: MayQueen+Nyan²? Why there?
units.displayText: MayQueen+Nyan²? Why there?

spans.text: MayQueen+Nyan²? Why there?

units.rawText: Do you have a memory problem, beanpole? Didn't you just say you were going to look for clues about Miss Mayuri with Kurisu?
units.displayText: Do you have a memory problem, beanpole? Didn't you just say you were going to look for clues about Miss Mayuri with Kurisu?

spans.text: Do you have a memory problem, beanpole? Didn't you just say you were going to look for clues about Miss Mayuri with Kurisu?

units.rawText: Okabe, you suggested it yourself. Do you not remember?
units.displayText: Okabe, you suggested it yourself. Do you not remember?

spans.text: Okabe, you suggested it yourself. Do you not remember?

units.rawText: Mayuri...
units.displayText: Mayuri...

spans.text: Mayuri...

units.rawText: Okarin, didn't you say that you'd find Mayushii, no matter where Mayushii went?
units.displayText: Okarin, didn't you say that you'd find Mayushii, no matter where Mayushii went?

spans.text: Okarin, didn't you say that you'd find Mayushii, no matter where Mayushii went?

units.rawText: So pull yourself together, Okarin.
units.displayText: So pull yourself together, Okarin.

spans.text: So pull yourself together, Okarin.

units.rawText: Do it for Kurisu-chan... No, do it for everyone in the Oasis and the Lab and send that D-Mail!
units.displayText: Do it for Kurisu-chan... No, do it for everyone in the Oasis and the Lab and send that D-Mail!

spans.text: Do it for Kurisu-chan... No, do it for everyone in the Oasis and the Lab and send that D-Mail!

units.rawText: I glance at my left hand.
units.displayText: I glance at my left hand.

spans.text: I glance at my left hand.

units.rawText: Mayuri's tightly-clenched hands are gone, left behind in the previous world line with her smile and the expectant look on her face.
units.displayText: Mayuri's tightly-clenched hands are gone, left behind in the previous world line with her smile and the expectant look on her face.

spans.text: Mayuri's tightly-clenched hands are gone, left behind in the previous world line with her smile and the expectant look on her face.

units.rawText: However, I have not forgotten the promise I made to Mayuri.
units.displayText: However, I have not forgotten the promise I made to Mayuri.

spans.text: However, I have not forgotten the promise I made to Mayuri.

units.rawText: Please be patient and listen to me, everyone.
units.displayText: Please be patient and listen to me, everyone.

spans.text: Please be patient and listen to me, everyone.

units.rawText: ...I came here from another world line.
units.displayText: ...I came here from another world line.

spans.text: ...I came here from another world line.

units.rawText: So you're saying that you came to this world line at the cost of Miss Mayuri disappearing?
units.displayText: So you're saying that you came to this world line at the cost of Miss Mayuri disappearing?

spans.text: So you're saying that you came to this world line at the cost of Miss Mayuri disappearing?

units.rawText: ...I can't even bring myself to laugh at that.
units.displayText: ...I can't even bring myself to laugh at that.

spans.text: ...I can't even bring myself to laugh at that.

units.rawText: ...I have a rough idea of the situation.
units.displayText: ...I have a rough idea of the situation.

spans.text: ...I have a rough idea of the situation.

units.rawText: Okabe, things in this world line are very different from what you experienced previously.
units.displayText: Okabe, things in this world line are very different from what you experienced previously.

spans.text: Okabe, things in this world line are very different from what you experienced previously.

units.rawText: Those... Entropics? The computer viruses that you said invaded the Oasis?
units.displayText: Those... Entropics? The computer viruses that you said invaded the Oasis?

spans.text: Those... Entropics? The computer viruses that you said invaded the Oasis?

units.rawText: Nothing like that happened on this world line. We have not had contact with the Entropics at all.
units.displayText: Nothing like that happened on this world line. We have not had contact with the Entropics at all.

spans.text: Nothing like that happened on this world line. We have not had contact with the Entropics at all.

units.rawText: What... The Entropics didn't invade the Oasis?!
units.displayText: What... The Entropics didn't invade the Oasis?!

spans.text: What... The Entropics didn't invade the Oasis?!

units.rawText: I look outside. The mood in the Oasis is relaxed and peaceful. There are no signs that it has ever experienced battle.
units.displayText: I look outside. The mood in the Oasis is relaxed and peaceful. There are no signs that it has ever experienced battle.

spans.text: I look outside. The mood in the Oasis is relaxed and peaceful. There are no signs that it has ever experienced battle.

units.rawText: To date, this is the only peaceful world line I have been to.
units.displayText: To date, this is the only peaceful world line I have been to.

spans.text: To date, this is the only peaceful world line I have been to.

units.rawText: Yes. After we crossed over, Kurisu was brought to the Lab and met up with you. She explained your situation to us.
units.displayText: Yes. After we crossed over, Kurisu was brought to the Lab and met up with you. She explained your situation to us.

spans.text: Yes. After we crossed over, Kurisu was brought to the Lab and met up with you. She explained your situation to us.

units.rawText: After that, we found Hashida, Luka and Faris.
units.displayText: After that, we found Hashida, Luka and Faris.

spans.text: After that, we found Hashida, Luka and Faris.

units.rawText: Currently, Hashida and Antonina have fixed Future Gadget No. 099. You can return to Akihabara at any time.
units.displayText: Currently, Hashida and Antonina have fixed Future Gadget No. 099. You can return to Akihabara at any time.

spans.text: Currently, Hashida and Antonina have fixed Future Gadget No. 099. You can return to Akihabara at any time.

units.rawText: ...What about Mayuri?
units.displayText: ...What about Mayuri?

spans.text: ...What about Mayuri?

units.rawText: I can feel my voice trembling.
units.displayText: I can feel my voice trembling.

spans.text: I can feel my voice trembling.

units.rawText: We... haven't found Mayuri yet. That's why we were waiting in the Lab.
units.displayText: We... haven't found Mayuri yet. That's why we were waiting in the Lab.

spans.text: We... haven't found Mayuri yet. That's why we were waiting in the Lab.

units.rawText: We tried calling Mayuri, but she seems to have turned off her cell phone and she isn't responding to mails.
units.displayText: We tried calling Mayuri, but she seems to have turned off her cell phone and she isn't responding to mails.

spans.text: We tried calling Mayuri, but she seems to have turned off her cell phone and she isn't responding to mails.

units.rawText: ...Have you tried pinpointing Mayuri's position?
units.displayText: ...Have you tried pinpointing Mayuri's position?

spans.text: ...Have you tried pinpointing Mayuri's position?

units.rawText: Green-Haired Loli slowly shakes her head.
units.displayText: Green-Haired Loli slowly shakes her head.

spans.text: Green-Haired Loli slowly shakes her head.

units.rawText: I've tried everything I could, but we haven't been able to find any trace of Miss Mayuri.
units.displayText: I've tried everything I could, but we haven't been able to find any trace of Miss Mayuri.

spans.text: I've tried everything I could, but we haven't been able to find any trace of Miss Mayuri.

units.rawText: While I was prepared to hear that, hearing those words still makes my heart sink.
units.displayText: While I was prepared to hear that, hearing those words still makes my heart sink.

spans.text: While I was prepared to hear that, hearing those words still makes my heart sink.

units.rawText: Just like what I feared, Mayuri's whereabouts in this world line are a mystery.
units.displayText: Just like what I feared, Mayuri's whereabouts in this world line are a mystery.

spans.text: Just like what I feared, Mayuri's whereabouts in this world line are a mystery.

units.rawText: It feels like I'm back to the beginning, unable to do anything but search aimlessly.
units.displayText: It feels like I'm back to the beginning, unable to do anything but search aimlessly.

spans.text: It feels like I'm back to the beginning, unable to do anything but search aimlessly.

units.rawText: However, I still have to do it. This is the promise I made to Mayuri.
units.displayText: However, I still have to do it. This is the promise I made to Mayuri.

spans.text: However, I still have to do it. This is the promise I made to Mayuri.

units.rawText: Muhahahaha! Don't make a face like that, assistant!
units.displayText: Muhahahaha! Don't make a face like that, assistant!

spans.text: Muhahahaha! Don't make a face like that, assistant!

units.rawText: <size=40>Making the impossible possible is Hououin Kyouma's stock in trade!</size>
units.displayText: Making the impossible possible is Hououin Kyouma's stock in trade!

spans.text: Making the impossible possible is Hououin Kyouma's stock in trade!

units.rawText: Okabe...
units.displayText: Okabe...

spans.text: Okabe...

units.rawText: Let's go, assistant! Didn't you say we were going to find Daru and the others? Then let's not waste time lollygagging around here!
units.displayText: Let's go, assistant! Didn't you say we were going to find Daru and the others? Then let's not waste time lollygagging around here!

spans.text: Let's go, assistant! Didn't you say we were going to find Daru and the others? Then let's not waste time lollygagging around here!

units.rawText: I'm heading off now! Don't get left behind!
units.displayText: I'm heading off now! Don't get left behind!

spans.text: I'm heading off now! Don't get left behind!

units.rawText: Honestly, what was all that about "not getting left behind"...
units.displayText: Honestly, what was all that about "not getting left behind"...

spans.text: Honestly, what was all that about "not getting left behind"...

units.rawText: You can't even keep up with me.
units.displayText: You can't even keep up with me.

spans.text: You can't even keep up with me.

units.rawText: Sh-shut up, assistant! I was just giving you a chance!
units.displayText: Sh-shut up, assistant! I was just giving you a chance!

spans.text: Sh-shut up, assistant! I was just giving you a chance!

units.rawText: And besides (pant) You stopped too, aren't you?!
units.displayText: And besides (pant) You stopped too, aren't you?!

spans.text: And besides (pant) You stopped too, aren't you?!

units.rawText: I'm just matching your pace!
units.displayText: I'm just matching your pace!

spans.text: I'm just matching your pace!

units.rawText: Both Kurisu and I are panting heavily while leaning against a wall.
units.displayText: Both Kurisu and I are panting heavily while leaning against a wall.

spans.text: Both Kurisu and I are panting heavily while leaning against a wall.

units.rawText: Why are we doing this? Competitiveness, of course.
units.displayText: Why are we doing this? Competitiveness, of course.

spans.text: Why are we doing this? Competitiveness, of course.

units.rawText: I probably won't be doing something like walking with all my might to outpace the competition again anytime soon.
units.displayText: I probably won't be doing something like walking with all my might to outpace the competition again anytime soon.

spans.text: I probably won't be doing something like walking with all my might to outpace the competition again anytime soon.

units.rawText: Whew, the maid cafe's air conditioning is a lifesaver.
units.displayText: Whew, the maid cafe's air conditioning is a lifesaver.

spans.text: Whew, the maid cafe's air conditioning is a lifesaver.

units.rawText: Oh yes, make sure you thank Mr. Willis, who invented the AC...
units.displayText: Oh yes, make sure you thank Mr. Willis, who invented the AC...

spans.text: Oh yes, make sure you thank Mr. Willis, who invented the AC...

units.rawText: Welcome back ~nya, Master♪
units.displayText: Welcome back ~nya, Master♪

spans.text: Welcome back ~nya, Master♪

units.rawText: Welcome back... master...nya...
units.displayText: Welcome back... master...nya...

spans.text: Welcome back... master...nya...

units.rawText: Hm...
units.displayText: Hm...

spans.text: Hm...

units.rawText: I know Mayuri isn't here, but part of me was still looking forward to her showing up.
units.displayText: I know Mayuri isn't here, but part of me was still looking forward to her showing up.

spans.text: I know Mayuri isn't here, but part of me was still looking forward to her showing up.

units.rawText: Faris-san, do you have news about Mayuri?
units.displayText: Faris-san, do you have news about Mayuri?

spans.text: Faris-san, do you have news about Mayuri?

units.rawText: Unfortunately not ~nya... Daru-nya is working hard to find Mayushii's signal, while Luka-nya, Erika-nya and the others have gone looking for her too ~nya!
units.displayText: Unfortunately not ~nya... Daru-nya is working hard to find Mayushii's signal, while Luka-nya, Erika-nya and the others have gone looking for her too ~nya!

spans.text: Unfortunately not ~nya... Daru-nya is working hard to find Mayushii's signal, while Luka-nya, Erika-nya and the others have gone looking for her too ~nya!

units.rawText: Don't worry, they'll contact us right away if they find anything ~nya!
units.displayText: Don't worry, they'll contact us right away if they find anything ~nya!

spans.text: Don't worry, they'll contact us right away if they find anything ~nya!

units.rawText: I see... Then I...
units.displayText: I see... Then I...

spans.text: I see... Then I...

units.rawText: Before I can finish, the cat-eared girl pinches my cheeks with both her hands and brings her face up to mine.
units.displayText: Before I can finish, the cat-eared girl pinches my cheeks with both her hands and brings her face up to mine.

spans.text: Before I can finish, the cat-eared girl pinches my cheeks with both her hands and brings her face up to mine.

units.rawText: Whasha doin?! Fayrish, wha ish thish?
units.displayText: Whasha doin?! Fayrish, wha ish thish?

spans.text: Whasha doin?! Fayrish, wha ish thish?

units.rawText: This look doesn't suit Kyouma-nya at all!
units.displayText: This look doesn't suit Kyouma-nya at all!

spans.text: This look doesn't suit Kyouma-nya at all!

units.rawText: Don't worry ~nya! Mayushii is a special being who was chosen by Faris ~nya! We'll find her for sure, Kyouma!
units.displayText: Don't worry ~nya! Mayushii is a special being who was chosen by Faris ~nya! We'll find her for sure, Kyouma!

spans.text: Don't worry ~nya! Mayushii is a special being who was chosen by Faris ~nya! We'll find her for sure, Kyouma!

units.rawText: Undinya, can you show Kyouma-nya a proper smile?
units.displayText: Undinya, can you show Kyouma-nya a proper smile?

spans.text: Undinya, can you show Kyouma-nya a proper smile?

units.rawText: Is it... like this... nya...?
units.displayText: Is it... like this... nya...?

spans.text: Is it... like this... nya...?

units.rawText: The girl tries her best to turn up the corners of her mouth with her index fingers.
units.displayText: The girl tries her best to turn up the corners of her mouth with her index fingers.

spans.text: The girl tries her best to turn up the corners of her mouth with her index fingers.

units.rawText: Yup! Full marks!
units.displayText: Yup! Full marks!

spans.text: Yup! Full marks!

units.rawText: <size=40>Muhahahaha! I can't believe even you were so easily baited, Catgirl!</size>
units.displayText: Muhahahaha! I can't believe even you were so easily baited, Catgirl!

spans.text: Muhahahaha! I can't believe even you were so easily baited, Catgirl!

units.rawText: Nyanya?!
units.displayText: Nyanya?!

spans.text: Nyanya?!

units.rawText: All that was just an act to throw off the Organization and get them to lower their guard! The real Hououin Kyouma would never give up because of something like that!
units.displayText: All that was just an act to throw off the Organization and get them to lower their guard! The real Hououin Kyouma would never give up because of something like that!

spans.text: All that was just an act to throw off the Organization and get them to lower their guard! The real Hououin Kyouma would never give up because of something like that!

units.rawText: Nyanya! Even Faris was taken in! Kyouma, this isn't an act, it's an illusion ~nya!
units.displayText: Nyanya! Even Faris was taken in! Kyouma, this isn't an act, it's an illusion ~nya!

spans.text: Nyanya! Even Faris was taken in! Kyouma, this isn't an act, it's an illusion ~nya!

units.rawText: In that case, Faris will have to fight it with the sealed forbidden spell...
units.displayText: In that case, Faris will have to fight it with the sealed forbidden spell...

spans.text: In that case, Faris will have to fight it with the sealed forbidden spell...

units.rawText: (Creak)
units.displayText: (Creak)

spans.text: (Creak)

units.rawText: As she says this, the door to the maid cafe opens and Faris smoothly switches back to her original maid mode to greet the newcomer.
units.displayText: As she says this, the door to the maid cafe opens and Faris smoothly switches back to her original maid mode to greet the newcomer.

spans.text: As she says this, the door to the maid cafe opens and Faris smoothly switches back to her original maid mode to greet the newcomer.

units.rawText: Ah, welcome back ~nya, Master♪
units.displayText: Ah, welcome back ~nya, Master♪

spans.text: Ah, welcome back ~nya, Master♪

units.rawText: Wait a minute! Since when did this place become a catgirl cafe?!
units.displayText: Wait a minute! Since when did this place become a catgirl cafe?!

spans.text: Wait a minute! Since when did this place become a catgirl cafe?!

units.rawText: —I know her.
units.displayText: —I know her.

spans.text: —I know her.

units.rawText: Yes, it's Riko. Who might you be, nii-chan? Are you a new customer for Riko?
units.displayText: Yes, it's Riko. Who might you be, nii-chan? Are you a new customer for Riko?

spans.text: Yes, it's Riko. Who might you be, nii-chan? Are you a new customer for Riko?

units.rawText: <size=60>WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU DOING HERE?!</size>
units.displayText: WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU DOING HERE?!

spans.text: WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU DOING HERE?!

units.rawText: Faris, get behind me right now! She's very dangerous!
units.displayText: Faris, get behind me right now! She's very dangerous!

spans.text: Faris, get behind me right now! She's very dangerous!

units.rawText: Assistant, hurry and call my comrade for help! Do it now!
units.displayText: Assistant, hurry and call my comrade for help! Do it now!

spans.text: Assistant, hurry and call my comrade for help! Do it now!

units.rawText: Nuwaaaah! What-what-what's going on?!
units.displayText: Nuwaaaah! What-what-what's going on?!

spans.text: Nuwaaaah! What-what-what's going on?!

units.rawText: Nyanya!? Kyouma, are you going back to that thing from before? You're scaring the customers!
units.displayText: Nyanya!? Kyouma, are you going back to that thing from before? You're scaring the customers!

spans.text: Nyanya!? Kyouma, are you going back to that thing from before? You're scaring the customers!

units.rawText: Okabe, cool it!
units.displayText: Okabe, cool it!

spans.text: Okabe, cool it!

units.rawText: This is not the world line from before!
units.displayText: This is not the world line from before!

spans.text: This is not the world line from before!

units.rawText: ...Huh?
units.displayText: ...Huh?

spans.text: ...Huh?

units.rawText: It is only then that I realize that there are no signs of Entropization on Riko. Right now, she is still the Trader that was described to me.
units.displayText: It is only then that I realize that there are no signs of Entropization on Riko. Right now, she is still the Trader that was described to me.

spans.text: It is only then that I realize that there are no signs of Entropization on Riko. Right now, she is still the Trader that was described to me.

units.rawText: After ensuring that she's not a threat, the operands in my hand dissipate once again.
units.displayText: After ensuring that she's not a threat, the operands in my hand dissipate once again.

spans.text: After ensuring that she's not a threat, the operands in my hand dissipate once again.

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry.

units.rawText: You scared the heck out of me, nii-chan! Normally, Riko would be demanding emotional damages from you!
units.displayText: You scared the heck out of me, nii-chan! Normally, Riko would be demanding emotional damages from you!

spans.text: You scared the heck out of me, nii-chan! Normally, Riko would be demanding emotional damages from you!

units.rawText: Seriously, what's been going on recently? Did Riko anger the gods or something?
units.displayText: Seriously, what's been going on recently? Did Riko anger the gods or something?

spans.text: Seriously, what's been going on recently? Did Riko anger the gods or something?

units.rawText: First the Sanctifiers impound my shipment, then this nii-chan I just met freaks out and almost blows me up because he thought I was a bad guy.
units.displayText: First the Sanctifiers impound my shipment, then this nii-chan I just met freaks out and almost blows me up because he thought I was a bad guy.

spans.text: First the Sanctifiers impound my shipment, then this nii-chan I just met freaks out and almost blows me up because he thought I was a bad guy.

units.rawText: Your shipment... was impounded... nya?
units.displayText: Your shipment... was impounded... nya?

spans.text: Your shipment... was impounded... nya?

units.rawText: Yes! The Sanctifiers took pretty much all my stock! Riko had to go reorder everything and Ksenia made sure to squeeze a huge chunk of late fees out of me...
units.displayText: Yes! The Sanctifiers took pretty much all my stock! Riko had to go reorder everything and Ksenia made sure to squeeze a huge chunk of late fees out of me...

spans.text: Yes! The Sanctifiers took pretty much all my stock! Riko had to go reorder everything and Ksenia made sure to squeeze a huge chunk of late fees out of me...

units.rawText: Well, nobody's been coming in because MayQueen+Nyan² ran out of supplies. Considering how empty the place is, it's no wonder Ksenyan's so mad.
units.displayText: Well, nobody's been coming in because MayQueen+Nyan² ran out of supplies. Considering how empty the place is, it's no wonder Ksenyan's so mad.

spans.text: Well, nobody's been coming in because MayQueen+Nyan² ran out of supplies. Considering how empty the place is, it's no wonder Ksenyan's so mad.

units.rawText: (Sigh) It's all because of those stupid Sanctifiers! Good thing Riko's kei van made it through or else that would have been terrible.
units.displayText: (Sigh) It's all because of those stupid Sanctifiers! Good thing Riko's kei van made it through or else that would have been terrible.

spans.text: (Sigh) It's all because of those stupid Sanctifiers! Good thing Riko's kei van made it through or else that would have been terrible.

units.rawText: Riko points to her kei van outside the store. The back is crammed full of stuff, to the point where the lid on the back can't even latch properly. It's hard to imagine how Riko can balance like this over long treks.
units.displayText: Riko points to her kei van outside the store. The back is crammed full of stuff, to the point where the lid on the back can't even latch properly. It's hard to imagine how Riko can balance like this over long treks.

spans.text: Riko points to her kei van outside the store. The back is crammed full of stuff, to the point where the lid on the back can't even latch properly. It's hard to imagine how Riko can balance like this over long treks.

units.rawText: ...Is, is this the kei van you drive?!
units.displayText: ...Is, is this the kei van you drive?!

spans.text: ...Is, is this the kei van you drive?!

units.rawText: Riko, you're amazing... nya...
units.displayText: Riko, you're amazing... nya...

spans.text: Riko, you're amazing... nya...

units.rawText: Hehe, it's a basic requirement for us Traders!
units.displayText: Hehe, it's a basic requirement for us Traders!

spans.text: Hehe, it's a basic requirement for us Traders!

units.rawText: Riko's not tooting Riko's own horn here; I can still balance this baby even with two more crates in the back! Naturally, that's while keeping all the cargo safe and sound, too.
